claim: Parameterized tactic generation consumes authenticated prior reward, planar progress, endpoint novelty, terminal outcome, and fitted-model ensemble uncertainty. The same generic family runtime generated and executed two decisions on the held-out Faron Woods start/goal pair without a route-specific preferred-action script.

implementation.feedback_identity: the latest replay transition whose authenticated after-state digest exactly matches the current retained state
feedback_fields: ensemble uncertainty for the prior exact action at the current state
whether the endpoint is a first visit
implementation.adaptation: Progress narrows heading probes and permits longer goal-seek duration; regression or a repeated endpoint widens heading and curve probes; ensemble uncertainty expands deterministic angular jitter.
implementation.serialization: Feedback is stored in the binary decision journal and projected into the human-readable v10 report. It is not a JSON checkpoint.

cargo_test_parameterized_tactic_proposal.specific_check: identical seed/state with measured regression, repeated endpoint, and nonzero uncertainty generates different exact instances under the same family schema

scope: This closes generic proposal generation and held-out runtime acceptance for P3. The two-decision Faron smoke did not reach terminal and is not a route-performance claim.
